name: Reckless Abandon
text: You fight like someone who has already decided how this ends. At the start of your turn you may declare yourself Reckless. Until your next turn, add one Vigor Die to the first melee Impact Roll you make, and every enemy attacking you Downgrades its first Impact Die against you.

name: The Primal Fury
text: Being struck at is the only invitation you have ever needed. The first time each round that an enemy targets you with an attack, whether or not it lands, you gain 1 Momentum. Ongoing damage, hazards, and traps do not stoke it — only a deliberate attempt on you.

name: Furious Strike
text: Your rage arrives in the blow itself, a moment after the blow does. When you deal damage with a melee attack, spend 1 Momentum to add one Vigor Die to that attack's Impact Roll.

name: Blood Armor
text: You flex into the hit instead of away from it. As a Reaction when you take damage, spend 1 Momentum, roll your Vigor Die, and reduce that damage by the result.

name: Wrathful Stride
text: Distance is an insult you correct at speed. For 1 AP and 1 Momentum, move up to 15ft in a straight line toward an enemy you can see. This movement ignores difficult terrain and provokes no Opportunity Attacks.

name: Goading Roar
text: You make yourself the only reasonable thing to be afraid of. For 1 AP and 1 Vigor Point, roll your Resolve Die against the Resolve Defense of every enemy within 15ft. On a hit the target is Dazed, and until the end of your next turn it Downgrades its Impact Die against anyone but you. On a Glancing Blow only the Downgrade applies.

name: Crimson Tide
text: You have never fought better than when you were losing. While you are at or below half your maximum Hit Points, the first melee attack you make each turn adds one Vigor Die to its Impact Roll.

name: Infectious Fury
text: Watching you take a blow and keep coming is worth more than anything you could say. When an enemy's attack against you results in a Glancing Blow, spend 1 Vigor Point and the nearest ally within 30ft who can see you gains 1 Momentum.

name: Blood for Blood
text: Requires any two Fury Majors. The debt comes due in the same breath it was incurred. As a Reaction when an enemy within your melee reach deals damage to you, spend 2 Momentum and 1 Vigor Point to make one melee attack against them. If that attack's Impact Die Explodes, you gain 1 Momentum.

name: Relentless
text: Your body finishes the argument your rage started. Once per combat, when you are reduced to 0 Hit Points, spend 2 Vigor Points to drop to 1 Hit Point instead. Your Momentum fills to its cap, and your next attack Explodes automatically. This does not prevent death from effects that bypass death saves.
